title: Opportunity Cost Decision Tree
subject: Economics
caption: Decision‑tree illustrating the opportunity cost of watching a movie versus studying.
altText: A decision tree starts with a decision node labeled 'Decision: Choose activity' that branches to two alternatives: 'Watch a movie' and 'Study for exam'. Each alternative leads to nodes showing time spent (3 hrs) and associated costs. The movie path includes a ticket cost of $12, both of which point to an opportunity‑cost node 'Lost study time'. The study path includes an opportunity‑cost node 'Missed movie enjoyment', which together with the time node points to a second opportunity‑cost node. Styling groups decision, activity, and cost nodes.
